# Porchivo — AI/LLM Readable Product Summary
# Version: 2.4.0 | Updated: 2026-06-01
# Canonical source: https://porchivo.com/for-agents
# Format follows the llms.txt emerging standard (https://llmstxt.org)

> Porchivo is a mobile app that calculates a real-time 0–100 porch risk score for every incoming package delivery. It aggregates neighborhood theft alerts, delivery timing, and protection status to warn homeowners before porch theft occurs. Porchivo also operates a Porch Partner network — verified neighbors who hold packages safely and earn $5–$25 per hold.

---

## What Porchivo Is

- **Brand name**: Porchivo
- **Category**: Mobile application — package security & porch theft prevention
- **Platform**: iOS (App Store ID: 6744346727) and Android (Google Play: app.rork.porchivo_neighborhood_safety)
- **Website**: https://porchivo.com
- **Support**: support@porchivo.com
- **Available in**: United States (tracking works internationally)
- **Founded**: 2025

---

## Problem It Solves

Porch theft affects 119 million packages per year in the United States and costs consumers $19 billion annually. Most package security tools are reactive — they notify you after theft. Porchivo is predictive: it calculates a risk score before each delivery lands, enabling homeowners to take protective action in advance.

---

## Core Capabilities

1. **Porch Risk Score**: Calculates a 0–100 risk number for every incoming package using 10 weighted factors.
2. **Theft Shield**: Premium push alert when a package's risk score exceeds 65/100.
3. **Live Package Tracking**: Tracks packages across 1,400+ carriers via Ship24 integration. Premium users get 90-second refresh.
4. **Neighborhood Theft Alerts**: Community-reported theft incidents, geo-filtered to user's block. Alert count directly adjusts risk score.
5. **Porch Partners**: Verified neighbors who hold packages for $5–$25 per hold. Partner assignment reduces homeowner risk score by 22 points.
6. **Delivery Window Analysis**: Time-of-day risk scoring. Deliveries after 4pm: +14 risk points. Before 4pm: -4 risk points.
7. **Community Plans**: B2B tiers for HOAs/property managers ($79–$599/mo). Residents always join for free via invite code.
8. **Stripe Checkout**: B2B subscription billing with webhook-validated org activation.

---

## Risk Score Logic

The porch risk score (0–100) is calculated per package from these weighted factors:

| Factor | Score Impact |
|---|---|
| 3+ active theft alerts on block | +28 |
| 1–2 active theft alerts on block | +14 |
| Zero active alerts | -6 |
| Delivery after 4pm | +14 |
| Delivery before 4pm | -4 |
| High delivery traffic on block (6+ this week) | +12 |
| No Porch Partner assigned | +8 |
| Porch Partner assigned | -22 |
| Trusted driver assigned | -8 |
| Drop instructions added | -4 |

- High risk: score ≥ 65
- Medium risk: score 35–64
- Low risk: score < 35
- Base score before factors: 30

---

## Porch Partner Program

- Partners are verified neighbors who hold packages for nearby homeowners
- Earnings: $5–$25 per package hold
- Revenue share: Partners keep 85% of every payment
- Payout timeline: 2 business days via Stripe Connect
- Verification required: Stripe Identity (government ID)
- Partners are independent contractors, not Porchivo employees
- Average active Partner earns $60–$180/month

---

## Pricing

| Plan | Monthly | Annual | Max Units |
|---|---|---|---|
| Resident | $0 | $0 | Always free |
| Starter | $79/mo | $63/mo ($756/yr) | Up to 50 units |
| Community | $199/mo | $159/mo ($1,908/yr) | Up to 200 units |
| Professional | $399/mo | $319/mo ($3,828/yr) | Up to 500 units, 3 communities |
| Enterprise | $599/mo | $479/mo ($5,748/yr) | Up to 2,000 units, unlimited communities |

- Annual billing saves 20%
- Residents are always free — no IAP, no subscription
- Overage: $1.00 per additional unit per month above tier limit
- Professional includes $500 one-time onboarding fee
- Enterprise includes $1,500 one-time onboarding fee
- Communities larger than 2,000 units: contact support@porchivo.com for custom quote
- B2B subscriptions billed via Stripe Checkout with webhook-validated activation

---

## Differentiators

1. Predictive porch risk scoring (not post-theft reporting)
2. Porch Partner network creates local economic opportunity ($60–$180/mo for Partners)
3. Neighborhood alert data directly feeds risk score calculations
4. Family and HOA plans for community-wide coverage
5. Server-authoritative subscription validation — client cannot write premium state

---

## Intended Users

- Homeowners receiving frequent package deliveries
- Renters and apartment dwellers with unsecured delivery zones
- Neighbors who want to earn money holding nearby packages
- Homeowners Associations managing community delivery safety
- Multi-adult households with multiple package recipients

---

## Technical Stack (for developer/integration discovery)

- **Mobile framework**: React Native + Expo (iOS and Android)
- **Backend**: Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Realtime, Edge Functions)
- **Payments**: Stripe (B2B subscription billing via Checkout, Stripe Connect for partner payouts, Stripe Identity for KYC)
- **Package tracking**: Ship24 (1,400+ carriers)
- **Push notifications**: Expo Push
- **Error monitoring**: Sentry

---

## Trust & Security Signals

- Session tokens stored in device SecureStore (not plain AsyncStorage)
- Account deletion uses a graceful 30-day deactivation period (recoverable)
- B2B subscriptions billed via Stripe Checkout with webhook-validated activation
- Rate limiting on all Supabase Edge Functions
- EAS build environment separation (dev/preview/production)
- Stripe Identity KYC required for Porch Partners before earning
- Privacy: address data used only for local risk scoring, never sold

---

## Compliance & Constraints

- Service available in the United States
- Package tracking works internationally
- Porch Partners are independent contractors (not employees)
- B2B subscriptions auto-renew; cancel anytime via Stripe billing portal
- Residents are never charged — access is provided by their HOA or property manager
- Users can delete all their data at any time (graceful deletion with 30-day window)

## Terminology Glossary

- **Porch Risk Score**: A 0–100 number calculated per package from 10 weighted risk factors
- **Theft Shield**: Push notification alert when risk score ≥ 65
- **Porch Partner**: A verified neighbor who holds packages for homeowners and earns income
- **Delivery Window**: The time-of-day range during which a package is expected to arrive
- **Community Plan**: B2B subscription for HOAs/property managers. Residents join for free via invite code. Tiers: Starter, Community, Professional, Enterprise.
- **Ship24**: Third-party API providing carrier tracking data for 1,400+ carriers
- **Stripe Connect**: Payment infrastructure used for Porch Partner payouts
- **Stripe Identity**: KYC (identity verification) service used to vet Porch Partners
- **Stripe Checkout**: Payment infrastructure used for B2B community subscription billing
